senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. כֹּחַ) to be firm, stand, be right.—Denom. נֹכַח.

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 31a">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> sq. (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 1:14">I Sam. I, 14</cite>) <he>מכאן … שצריך להוֹכִיחוֹ</he> from here we learn that he who sees in his neighbor something unbecoming, is bound to admonish him; <cite ref="Arakhin 16b">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>הוֹכִיחוֹ … ויוֹכִיהֶנּוּ</he> if he did admonish him and he did not heed it, he must do it again.
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b:19">Ib.</cite> … <he>תמיהני שיודע להוכיח</he> I wonder whether there is in this generation one who knows how to admonish; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to prove, to serve as an analogy.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 6a:9">B. Kam. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אש תּוֹכִיחַ</he> let the law concerning incendiary (<cite ref="Exodus 22:5">Ex. XXII, 5</cite>) be taken as a standard (it being the result of human action); <he>בור תוכיח</he> let the law about a pit (ib. XXI, 33) decide (it being stationary).
Kidd. 7ᵃ; a. v. fr.— to be evidence, to show.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 4b:13">M. Kat. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>זיבלו מוֹכִיחַ עליו</he> his dung shows what he is about doing; a. fr.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>בא הקב״ה לה׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord came to argue with Israel; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:6">ib.</cite> <he>כלום אינון יכולין לה׳ עם בוראן</he> can they argue (successfully) with their Creator?; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> <he>מי יוכל לִיוָּכֵחַ וכ׳</he> (not <he>לוו׳</he>) who dares to argue with &c.
